variant: third generation: driverless asphalt paver with double-drum and pneumatic rollers
name: SANY autonomous paving & compaction fleet
summary: Fleet of driverless SANY road machines in which an autonomous asphalt paver is followed by double-drum and pneumatic rollers that adjust their compaction on their own. SANY says the third generation detects kerbs, avoids obstacles with LiDAR and cameras and has been used on more than 50 projects in China.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU offer for the driverless fleet found; all projects named are in China. SANY's single driverless roller (SSR200C-10S kit) is a separate record and is also not offered in Germany.

specs.label: Generation
specs.value: third generation since the first fleet in 2019
specs.quote: Since launching its first-generation unmanned road machine fleet in 2019, SANY has developed it to the third generation

specs.label: Surface flatness
specs.quote: Automatically adjust compaction methods based on site conditions while ensuring surface layer flatness (σ < 0.75 mm).

specs.label: On-site workforce saved
specs.quote: Unmanned driving system, LiDAR & vision fusion for obstacle avoidance, reducing over 60% on-site workforce.

specs.label: Kerb detection
specs.value: perception and positioning for kerb detection, 'zero-edge deviation'
specs.quote: Self-developed technology integrating perception and positioning for precise curb detection, enabling zero-edge deviation.

specs.label: Projects
specs.quote: The autonomous fleet has now been deployed in over 50 projects in China.

notes: A fleet of conventional SANY road machines made driverless; rollers roll on steel drums and tyres (counted as wheels here); paver undercarriage not stated.
Machine models in the fleet are not named in the source read.
Tool = paver screed and roller drums.
